mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%) compress risk-free discount rates, increasing equity valuation multiples and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >45% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad consumer demand deterioration, triggering negative earnings expectations and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100 signals robust manufacturing output growth that strengthens corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 100 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 7.0% for two consecutive months indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when UNRATE < 7.0 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 850,000 units per month signals strong residential construction activity that stimulates consumer spending and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of months when HOUST > 850,000 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized) and industrial production expansion (INDPRO > 100) indicate synchronized demand-supply strength that elevates corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint growth of GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict positive returns in >55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 232.0 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 232.0 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).
